limits: Review is a heuristic for paired delimiters crossing inline nodes with math-like content or known commands. It does not reconstruct arbitrary equations, parse printed mathematics, certify mathematical truth or combine markup across block/code boundaries.

Without source TeX, the available textual representation can omit spatial structure. The imported original remains authoritative. A simple source-attributed inline container without independent structural cues is treated as one formula.
Tests in this receipt do not use provider sessions, operating-system clipboard, physical assistive technology, or visual inspection.
